122.speaker: Player_Romus

123.speaker: Player_Romus
123.text: "Much blood was shed, but I am pleased to say that the Reinharts' reign of terror has come to an end. Rizia has taken the people of Pales under our wing."

124.speaker: Player_Romus

125.speaker: Player_Romus
125.text: "Now Pales as a separate entity is no more! The former Grand Duchy has now been integrated into our kingdom, and we shall work towards rebuilding it as fast as we can."

126.speaker: Player_Romus
126.text: "It took much hardship, but the cities of Arces and Ziqes were finally restored to Rizia. We have been waiting for this moment for a long time."

127.speaker: Player_Romus
127.text: "The bloodshed was worth it. With our annexation of the northern territories of the Grand Duchy, we liberated the many Rizians living in the region from Palesian rule."

128.speaker: Player_Romus
128.text: "When I was in Pales, I talked to many Palesians who desired to be part of Rizia. Now, I'm overjoyed that northern Pales is with us once more."

129.speaker: Player_Romus
129.text: "Now, Pales has been divided! The Rizian parts of Pales have been reintegrated into our kingdom, and we will work closely with the Grand Duchy to bring stability to the region."

131.speaker: Player_Romus

132.speaker: Player_Romus

133.speaker: Player_Romus

256.speaker: Player_Romus

807.speaker: Player_Romus
807.text: "I will live as a commoner, with no special honors or privileges to my name. Today I am your king, but tomorrow, I will be one of you."
807.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Arrested"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Executed"] == false) == false

808.speaker: Player_Romus
808.text: "Under the new leadership, we will embark on an era of promise and potential, continuing to build a Rizia that shines as a beacon of hope, prosperity, and peace."

809.speaker: Player_Romus
809.text: "In closing, I offer my deepest gratitude for the privilege of serving as your king. The challenges we have surmounted together, and the dreams we have nurtured will forever remain with me."

810.speaker: Player_Romus
810.text: "As I step into a new role, my commitment to Rizia and its people remains unshaken, bound by a love for our land that is as eternal as the stars under which it rests."

811.speaker: Player_Romus
811.text: "Never forget that your King loves you. That if given the chance, I would have fought for you until the very last beat of my heart."

813.speaker: Player_Romus
813.text: "Together, we are invincible. Together, we are Rizia. Long live Rizia."

814.speaker: Player_Romus
814.text: "I thank you all from a full heart. God bless you all."

817.speaker: Player_Romus
817.text: "I wish the new regime all the luck in the world."

865.text: "You and your kind no longer pose a threat to me or anyone. You may go."

866.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
866.text: "But first, I'm going to need that... *thing* on your head."

867.speaker: Narrator
867.text: At the last moment, an aide placed the Toras crown upon my head.

868.speaker: Narrator
868.text: His eyes traveled upwards towards the Toras crown. I'd almost forgotten I was wearing it.

871.speaker: Player_Romus
871.text: "Fine! Take the stupid crown! I'll step down without a fight."

872.speaker: Narrator
872.text: Without so much as glancing at it, he hurled it to the ground. It made a cracking noise as it hit the stone floor.

874.speaker: Narrator
874.text: Once more, an enormous mass of people filled the palace gardens. But instead of shouting my praise, they were cheering my downfall.

875.speaker: Narrator
875.text: Banners of revolution waved proudly as fireworks illuminated the sky.

880.speaker: Narrator
880.text: He turned away as his people wrenched the crown off my head.

881.speaker: Narrator
881.text: They began dragging me towards the main doors. Suddenly, he put up a hand.

883.speaker: Narrator
883.text: Rifles prodded my back as I was forced towards the staircase at the back of the hall. The same one I'd ascended right after my coronation.

885.speaker: Narrator
885.text: The group of revolutionaries who'd been watching stood stone-faced as I left the desk.

886.speaker: Player_Romus
886.text: "I wish you all the best of luck."

887.speaker: Player_Romus
887.text: "I kept up my end of the bargain. Am I free to leave now?"

888.speaker: Player_Romus
888.text: "I have to say, I'm relieved. A great burden has been lifted today."

889.speaker: Player_Romus
889.text: "Oh, come on. I thought it was a pretty good speech."

891.speaker: Narrator
891.text: One of the group stepped forward and reached her arm towards the crown on my head.

894.speaker: Narrator
894.text: Her associates pinned my arms behind my back as they wrenched the crown off my head.

895.speaker: Narrator
895.text: Handcuffs were unceremoniously slapped on my wrists. Prodding me with their rifles, the group forced me up the staircase in back of the hall. The same one I'd ascended right after my coronation.

898.speaker: Player_Romus
898.text: "But that doesn't mean Rizia has to give Adarfo Sotelato the reins. It doesn't mean you should accept his band of thugs taking over."

902.speaker: Player_Romus
902.text: "But that doesn't mean Rizia has to give radical militants the reins. It doesn't mean you should accept this band of thugs taking over."

903.speaker: Narrator
903.text: Before I could finish the words, the microphone was cut.

904.speaker: Narrator
904.text: A hand gripped my shoulder and shoved me aside.

908.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
908.text: "What do you think you're doing, Toras?"

909.speaker: Narrator
909.text: "What do you think you're doing?" she hissed. "You've overstepped."

910.speaker: Narrator
910.text: The cameras were turned off immediately as they pulled me back behind the curtains.

917.speaker: Player_Romus
917.text: "I shall conclude by extending my deepest gratitude to Prime Minister Adarfo Sotelato, whose leadership during this transitional period has been marked by wisdom, integrity, and commitment to the democratic ideals that are now the bedrock of our reformed monarchy."

922.speaker: Player_Romus
922.text: "I only said what needed to be said."

923.speaker: Player_Romus
923.text: "I offered my perspective. The people will decide what to do with it."

924.speaker: Player_Romus
924.text: "I don't believe I said anything wrong."

926.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
926.text: "You went off-script. That wasn't our agreement."

927.speaker: Player_Romus
927.text: "It's done now. Just let me go."

928.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
928.text: "I'm afraid it's too late for that."

929.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
929.text: "Fine. I'm not going to waste my breath arguing with you."

937.speaker: Narrator

938.speaker: Narrator
938.text: The hall, usually echoing with the whisper-quiet footsteps of courtiers, was transformed into a hive of chaos as the film crew set up cameras, lights and microphones under the watchful eye of the revolutionaries.

945.speaker: Narrator
945.text: The revolutionaries stared back at me, with arms crossed and eyes narrowed.

949.speaker: Player_Romus
949.text: "As we approach the upcoming elections, it is imperative that we continue on this path of progress. I encourage all Rizians to support candidates whose leadership will best ensure the long-term security and stability of this nation."

950.speaker: Player_Romus
950.text: "Mr. Sazon has my full confidence, and with elections drawing near, I urge the people of Rizia to support him and the RPP for lasting equality and rights for all citizens."

951.speaker: Player_Romus
951.text: "As our nation stands at this pivotal moment, I urge every Rizian to exercise their right by casting their vote."

955.speaker: Player_Romus
955.text: "Baroness de Rava has my full confidence, and with elections drawing near, I urge the people of Rizia to support her and the RNC for lasting security and stability."

956.speaker: Player_Romus
956.text: "But rather than endorse a single candidate or party in this election, I trust that you, the people, will choose the leaders who best represent our nation's future."

961.speaker: Player_Romus

982.speaker: Player_Romus
982.text: “It gives me no great pleasure to relinquish my crown. Yet I know God has guided me to this moment.”

986.speaker: Player_Romus
986.text: “I have done much from this throne, but I was only the vessel -- what came through me was guided by His will.”

990.speaker: Player_Romus
990.text: "I want to congratulate our parliament in drafting the new constitution. Together, with God's guidance, we have brought historic reforms to our kingdom."

991.speaker: Player_Romus
991.text: "The days of monarchs leading their soldiers into battle are behind us. I may no longer lead from the front, but I remain a servant of this kingdom -- and of God. I pledge my heart and devotion to this peninsula, and to all the peoples of our realm."

995.speaker: Player_Romus
995.text: “Our constitution reflects not just civic change, but divine alignment. Justice belongs to both crown and Creator.”

999.speaker: Player_Romus
999.text: "A ruler does not hold power by his own strength alone, and when God whispers that the season has changed, we must listen."

1003.speaker: Player_Romus
1003.text: "I stand humbled by the blessings the Lord has granted us throughout my time on the throne."
1003.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_Rizia_Unification"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Pales_Won"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Success"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.ZilleReturn_Success"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_Intermerkopum"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Pales_Loss"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Outcome_NoPeace_KeepFighting"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Pales_Operation1_Won"] == false) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Trait_ReligiousKing"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Theocracy_Full"] == true)

1007.speaker: Player_Romus

1011.speaker: Player_Romus
1011.text: "As God tests the hearts of men, I ask you to stand firm — in patience, in faith, and in unity."

1015.speaker: Player_Romus
1015.text: "It is by God’s will that Zille, once veiled in sorrow, now stands redeemed."
1015.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_Rizia_Unification"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.War_BorderOutcome_Peace_Annexation"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Trait_ReligiousKing"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Theocracy_Full"] == true)

1019.speaker: Player_Romus
1019.text: "Together, let us prove that reform need not divide, but can uplift us -- uniting Rizia under the purpose God has set before us."

1023.speaker: Player_Romus
1023.text: "With God as my witness, I give you my solemn word..."

1033.speaker: Player_Romus
1033.text: "However, I believe it is her opponent who deserves your vote. The Rizian People's Party's vision and platform make it the clear choice."

1040.speaker: Player_Romus
1040.text: "As we approach the upcoming elections, it is imperative that we continue on this path of progress. I encourage all Rizians to support candidates whose leadership will best ensure a high standard of living for all."

1044.speaker: Player_Romus
1044.text: "Yet I believe it is his opponent that deserves your ballot. Daria de Rava and the Rizian National Coalition represent the values that we as Rizians hold dear. I urge you to cast your vote for them."

1046.speaker: Player_Romus
1046.text: "Daria de Rava of the Rizian National Coalition shall go down in history as the first Prime Minister of Rizia."

1048.speaker: Player_Romus
1048.text: "When it came time to appoint an interim Prime Minister, I chose the person I believed would best support the nation during this delicate transition of power."

1049.speaker: Player_Romus
1049.text: "Adarfo Sotelato of the Rizian People's Party shall go down in history as the first Prime Minister of Rizia."

1050.speaker: Player_Romus
1050.text: "I know that Adarfo Sotelato was an unconventional choice for interim Prime Minister. But he was the leader who represented the kingdom's new drive for change."

1051.speaker: Player_Romus
1051.text: "Manus Sazon shall go down in history as the man who helped bring reform to Rizia."

1055.speaker: Player_Romus
1055.text: "In appointing an interim Prime Minister, I chose the person I believed would best support the nation during this delicate transition of power."

1058.speaker: Player_Romus
1058.text: "Mr. Sotelato has my full confidence, and with elections drawing near, I urge the people of Rizia to support him and the RPP for lasting equality and rights for all citizens."
